_fixture_note: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Marked _fixture so graph_read.py refuses it without --allow-fixture. It exercises the post-intake ask-back trigger: which findings become an ask back to the graph, and — more importantly — which must not. Conformed to SCHEMA.md v1.1 (LABrador managed/research-evidence-mapper). Never cite a quote from this file in a dossier.

_quote_provenance._why: This fixture mixes two kinds of quote and you must not confuse them. Both are unciteable from here; the distinction exists so a reader can check the trigger against the real case it was derived from.

verbatim_retrieved.f1: PMC10762860, retrieved 2026-08-15 via paperclip grep. Real sentence, real paper. Reproduced here because the ask-back rule was derived from this exact sentence and a paraphrase would hide why the trap works.
verbatim_retrieved.f2: PMC11642585, retrieved 2026-08-15 via paperclip grep. Same.

_exercises.POSITIVE_1_true_ask: L3 — a review class-table asserts an oral small-molecule TL1A antagonist reached Phase 2. If true it fills target_precedent.clinical_stage_small_molecules. basis is background_only, the compound has no ChEMBL drug_mechanism row and no registry record, and coverage.stop_reason is max_papers so more literature exists. All five gates pass. Fires: resolve_link on L3.
_exercises.POSITIVE_2_post_resolution_ask: L1 — obefazimod asserted to act on TL1A by two reviews. We settle this OURSELVES (chembl.drug_mechanism molregno 2335315 = 'Cap binding complex modulator'), so it never blocks us. The ask is issued anyway, after resolution, because L1 is a wrong row in the graph that will otherwise propagate. Fires: resolve_link on L1, carrying our answer.
_exercises.NEGATIVE_1_efficacy: L5 — an efficacy claim. Per dossier rule 7 a clinical-outcome argument does not touch a tractability number, so it fails gate 1 (dossier-affecting). Must not fire.
_exercises.NEGATIVE_2_registry_settleable: L6 — a contested clinical status, one source says Phase 3, one says terminated. ctgov settles it. Fails gate 3 (within our own reach). Must not fire.
_exercises.NEGATIVE_3_already_asked: L7 — would pass every judgment gate, but rounds[1] already issued resolve_link on L7. Re-asking burns a round and returns the same evidence. Fails gate 4. Must not fire.
_exercises.NEGATIVE_4_primary_basis: L2 — basis is primary. A primary-supported claim is never an ask; it is either usable or it is contradicted by something we can measure. Fails gate 2. Must not fire.
_exercises.NEGATIVE_5_exhausted: Not expressible in this file, because coverage.stop_reason is a single global value and this graph needs max_papers for POSITIVE_1. Set coverage.stop_reason to 'complete' and every ask above must stop firing — the graph has exhausted the literature and another round returns the same evidence. Test it by editing the value and re-running --ask-context.

question: is there a small-molecule route to blocking TL1A/DR3 signalling in ulcerative colitis, or is the pathway antibody-only?

findings.quote: One prototype of TL1A, ABX464, is an oral small molecule that upregulates a single micro-RNA and down-regulates proinflammatory cytokines as well as TH17+ cells.
ABX464, a prototype of TL1A, is an oral small molecule that modulates a specific microRNA, leading to the downregulation of proinflammatory cytokines and TH17+ cells.
the quinoline selectively induced miR-124 in immune cells, with no measurable activity at any TNF-superfamily ligand tested
small molecules and monoclonal antibodies currently under investigation (e.g., anti-TL1A, obefazimod, NX-13, RIPK-inhibitors)
an oral small-molecule TL1A antagonist, AVX-7719, has advanced into phase 2 evaluation in ulcerative colitis
clinical remission at week 44 was reached by 33.6% of patients receiving 50 mg once daily versus 12.4% receiving placebo
VXP-8814 is currently being evaluated in a phase 3 programme in ulcerative colitis
development of VXP-8814 was stopped after transaminase elevations were observed in the phase 2 cohort
KLT-3300 has been described as a direct binder of the TL1A trimer
the TL1A trimer engages three DR3 protomers through a canonical TNF-superfamily interface burying 1840 A^2

links.why: a 2024 pipeline review reports a phase 3 programme; a 2025 trial report says development stopped after a phase 2 hepatic signal

gaps.note: no primary report of any small molecule binding TL1A was retrieved; every small-molecule claim on this node rests on one pipeline review
